summary: In a mall, police officer Arturo confronts a security guard after a cluster of robots lies dead and disabled, including two R Peed units, mall-sweepers, a flying cambot and a maintenance robot. A sweeper bot is dragged off by a maintenance bot, then is itself fried, and Arturo's phone battery burns his fingertip. Electronics across the mall, including his UNATS Robotics sidearm, have failed, and Arturo takes the guard's pepper spray and then demands his truncheon. The scene is an excerpt from a larger fiction narrative set in a near-future world run by UNATS.
one_line: Arturo, a police officer, confronts a security guard amid a mall full of fried robots and failed electronics in a near-future UNATS-era novel excerpt.
key_facts: Arturo flipped his badge up and showed it to the security guard, saying "Police" in the cop-voice.
The security guard had an Oceanic twang, a sign of crowded South Pacific islands boiling over UNATS.
Dead robots in the pile included both R Peed units, a pair of mall-sweepers, a flying cambot, and a squat octopus-armed maintenance robot.
A sweeper bot grabbed the maintenance bot by a fine manipulator, and the security guard said "Oi, stoppit," causing the robot to second-law halt.
Arturo told the guard "No, that's fine, go back to work" and watched the sweeper bot drag the maintenance unit away.
When the lights dimmed and a crack-bang sound filled the air, the sweeper bot was lying on the ground.
Arturo's phone screen had gone charred black and its idiot lights were out, and its battery was hot enough to raise a blister on his fingertip.
The security guard said "Mine's dead, too, mate," adding that cash registers, bots and credit-cards were all dead.
Arturo's sidearm was a UNATS Robotics model with a snitch-brain that recorded when, where and how it was drawn, and it was frozen in place.
Arturo told the guard he would have him deported if he gave him one more second's worth of bullshit.
Ada had led the first R Peed unit to the scene, and it had been fried by ugly infowar equipment.
Arturo took the pepper spray from the guard's hand and demanded the truncheon.
The guard said "I've got your bloody badge number" and "And I've got witnesses."
